name: Tag
description: Displays a compact label with optional icon and dismissal.

attributes.name: dismiss-value
attributes.description: Adds a value to the dismiss event.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Sets a Noora icon before the label.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A custom icon that takes precedence over the icon attribute.

events.name: noora-dismiss
events.description: Emitted when the tag dismiss control is activated.

examples.title: Basic tags
examples.description: Render plain tags and tags with different icons.
examples.markup:
<noora-tag label="Simple Tag"></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="Category" icon="category"></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="User" icon="user"></noora-tag>

examples.title: Dismissible states
examples.description: Allow removal when a tag represents editable input.
examples.markup:
<noora-tag label="Dismissible Tag" icon="category" dismissible></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="Fixed Tag" icon="category"></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="Remove Me" dismissible></noora-tag>

examples.title: Disabled states
examples.description: Disable plain, icon, and dismissible tags.
examples.markup:
<noora-tag label="Disabled Tag" disabled></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="Disabled" icon="category" disabled></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="Disabled Dismissible" icon="category" dismissible disabled></noora-tag>

examples.title: Content variations
examples.description: Support short, long, version, and status labels.
examples.markup:
<noora-tag label="New" dismissible></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="Very Long Tag Label That Might Wrap" icon="category" dismissible></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="v2.1.0" icon="git_branch"></noora-tag>
<noora-tag label="In Progress" icon="progress_x" dismissible></noora-tag>
